ports.publicRelayWhy: The edge VPS (vm-control) DNATs this UDP range to the WireGuard relay peer, so a production tile whose udpPort falls OUTSIDE it is unreachable from the public gallery while looking perfectly healthy on the box: the service is active, the ticket check passes, signalling returns a valid path, and the daemon simply never sees a session. That is exactly how oricatmos/kc854/sinclairql/nextstep (54131-54134) shipped broken on 2026-08-09 against an edge capped at 54130. Widened to 54200 (slot 200) to give the lineup real headroom. MUST match nftables on the edge and the range quoted in docs/PUBLIC-GALLERY.md.

fleetEncoder.bufsizeRatioWhy: VBV bufsize = ratio x maxrate: the bits the encoder may spend in one burst. 0.5 keeps a heartbeat IDR from flooding a bufferbloated WAN queue in one go, at the cost of harder transient quantisation. Applied fleet-wide by hand on 2026-07-17 and never recorded here, so a registry re-emit would have silently restored 1.0 on 30 tiles. Note the daemon already enforces min(ratio, 0.5) on ABR tiers >= 1 and tier 0 is CQP with no VBV at all, so this value changes no behaviour today - it is captured so the two cannot disagree.

goldenComment: Golden reset manifest for the 26 streamhost input-regression tiles plus the 4 emulator-bridge retro tiles (c64/atarist/apple2/amiga; on those, mouse/keyboard 'UNVERIFIED' = input verdicts not yet pixel-certified). Keyed by osId (the SPA ?streamhost=<osId> id, the /signal/<osId>.json key, and the /restore/<osId> path segment). resetMode=loadvm restores the in-qcow2 live `golden` snapshot via QMP (fast, no restart, RAM+devices exact); resetMode=restart cold-boots the tile's curated fixture by re-running qemu-streamhost.sh + restarting streamhost@ (for tiles whose backing store cannot hold a vmstate snapshot). NON-DESTRUCTIVE: reset only restores/relaunches, it never runs savevm. mouse/keyboard = the visually-certified per-input verdict (PASS = a reaction was pixel-verified on the guest's QMP framebuffer by an agent reading before/after PNGs; SKIP = input IS delivered over the open control channel but a documented guest limitation prevents pixel-verification off the captured VGA framebuffer).
actionMapReadme: Per-OS action map for gallery-perf-probe.mjs / gallery-input-probe.py. Keyed by osKey (service name minus 'osgallery-' prefix and '-N' suffix; doubled tokens like os2warp-os2warp collapse to os2warp). Fields: win = X window to activate ('qemu' class, or 'name:FreeRDP'); mouse.a/mouse.b = two X:99 coords inside the guest content to move the cursor between (must land on rendered guest pixels; console/text OSes have no cursor -> mouse=N/A, expect misses); kbd = xdotool arg ('super','ctrl+Escape', or 'type:X'); kbd_reset = key(s) to restore baseline (joined with '+space+' for multiple); audio_trigger = 'tone' (paplay a 440Hz sine into the neko-captured sink audio_output; OS-agnostic; measures neko-encode+transport continuity) or 'guest:<cmd>' or 'none'. The audio DEVICE (sb16/ac97/hda/none) is auto-detected live from the QEMU cmdline; this file only carries input hints. 'validated:true' = numbers captured this run.

actionMapDefault.kbd_note: fallback: Super opens a Start menu on Windows-like GUIs; unverified elsewhere
